description:
Make the CLI and server document history read the git module's path history instead of walking history in libgit2.

## Background

- `get_file_history` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:864-914`) walks the whole history from `HEAD` in libgit2. It lists a commit whose tree holds the path when the path is added or its blob differs from the first parent's; a commit deleting the path is never listed, and a merge is compared with its first parent only.
- `document_history` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:556-579`) fails outside git; `get_document_history` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:731-754`) returns an empty list there. Both produce `CommitInfo` with a seven-character id, the author name, the commit time as `%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S` UTC and the trimmed message.
- `GitCheckout::file_history(path)` returns the path's commits under git's default history simplification.
- The server route fixture `test_document_reads_serve_a_derived_document_without_a_link` now uses the shared non-Git `setup_test_repo_with_config`, then initializes Git in its owned temporary root. Bind detected paths after that initialization using its actual selected data root; its history and diff assertions remain unchanged.
- Tests: `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/document_history_tests.rs:108` onwards.
- Kept as one change for a build reason: `get_file_history` is private, and an uncalled private method fails the zero-warning build.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Both variants map `file_history` of the executor's git checkout to `CommitInfo` as today, `get_file_history` no longer exists, and neither variant uses git2.
- [hard] REQ-02: CLI tests assert the behaviour change: a commit that deletes the document is listed (today omitted, so this assertion fails on today's code), and a merge identical to one parent for it is omitted. The CLI command still fails outside git and the server variant still returns an empty list there.
- [hard] REQ-03: The existing real-Git route fixture supplies detected `WorktreePaths` through `with_worktree_paths` after Git initialization, using its actual selected data root and the same owned temporary root; `test_document_reads_serve_a_derived_document_without_a_link` keeps its assertions and passes.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: history follows git's default history simplification for the path.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Document history comes from the module's path history
